items.title: Trace elements offer new clues to mysterious black eye lesions in cats
items.summary: A distinctive black or dark brown lesion that appears on the eyes of some cats has long puzzled veterinarians. Now, researchers have identified two elements that may help explain what is happening inside the affected cornea.

items.title: Can math prove that Humpty Dumpty was simply mismanaged?
items.summary: Humpty Dumpty had all the king's horses and all the king's men, but it wasn't enough to put him back together again. This raises the question: How many horses and men did he actually need?
